inputs.text: The owner of Blue Waters is dead right that the government is slapping taxes on productive businesses without putting a single thing back into our communities or infrastructure. This environmental tax talk is just a thin cover for another government raid on companies that actually keep our social order intact and support our traditional way of life. Plastic bottles piling up in rivers and drains show these schemes do nothing to fix real problems. The proper path forward is through personal responsibility, strong family values, and respect for our communities, not handing more power to progressive institutions that weaken national strength and erode our heritage.
